name: write-file
description: Tests the write_file tool by asking the agent to create a new Swift file with a stub tool implementation following the existing TypedTool pattern found in the codebase.
task: Create a new file at Sources/Yrden/Tools/ListToolsTool.swift with a stub TypedTool implementation. First read Sources/Yrden/Tools/ReadFileTool.swift to understand the pattern, then create a new tool called 'list_tools' that would list available tools. The struct should be called ListToolsTool conforming to TypedTool, with a ListToolsArgs struct conforming to the @Schema pattern. The args should have a single optional 'filter' property of type String. The execute method can just return a .success("Not implemented yet") placeholder.
